data.name: RefreshTitle
data.comment: Title of the refresh link window.

data.name: RefreshAutomationName
data.comment: Name announced by screen readers for the refresh link window.

data.name: RefreshAsk
data.value: The link for {0} has expired. Kasi can open the page the download came from in your browser to get a new one, then carry on from where it stopped.
data.comment: {0} is the file name.

data.name: RefreshStart
data.comment: Button that asks the browser to open the page.

data.name: RefreshWaiting
data.value: Waiting for the browser. Keep the browser open; this can take up to a minute.
data.comment: Shown while the browser opens the page.

data.name: RefreshDone
data.value: The link was refreshed and the download continues.
data.comment: Shown after a successful refresh.

data.name: RefreshNoReferrer
data.value: Kasi does not know which page this download came from, so it cannot get a new link. Download it again from the page.
data.comment: Shown when the download has no referrer.

data.name: RefreshNoBrowser
data.value: No browser with the Kasi extension is connected. Open your browser and try again.
data.comment: Shown when no browser extension is connected.

data.name: RefreshTimedOut
data.value: The page did not start a download in time. Try again, or download the file again from the page.
data.comment: Shown when the browser found no download.

data.name: RefreshRejected
data.value: The new link serves a different file, so the download stays paused.
data.comment: Shown when the new link does not match the partly downloaded file.

data.name: RefreshFailed
data.value: The link could not be refreshed. The download stays paused.
data.comment: Shown when the refresh failed for another reason.

data.name: RefreshClose
data.comment: Button that closes the refresh link window.
